newsitem.title: USA: Avecor gets FDA clearance for product.
newsitem.headline: Avecor gets FDA clearance for product.

text.p: Avecor Cardiovascular Inc said Tuesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration has approved the company's request to market its new MYOtherm XP product, a medical device used in open-heart surgery.

The MYOtherm XP cardioplegia delivery system is second-generation technology for the product line and was designed to deliver greater customer convenience and improve manufacturing efficiency, the company said.
The new product will be introduced to customers in the United States and Europe during the third quarter, Avecor said.
